info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Payments Payments Disputes-v1-spec
info.description: The Payment Dispute Management API provides a streamlined solution for retrieving and managing payment disputes. This endpoint allows users to access detailed information related to various payment disputes, facilitating prompt resolution and enhanced customer satisfaction. Typical consumers include support teams and financial departments within organizations that handle payment transactions and disputes. By leveraging this API, users can efficiently track the status of disputes and retrieve historical data for analysis and reporting.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information regarding payment disputes. It is useful for customers and support teams to view the status and details of any disputes filed against transactions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve details about a specific payment dispute. It requires the payment dispute identifier and possibly other filters to narrow down the results.

ListPaymentsPaymentsDisputesRequest.description: The request body for the GET operation concerning payment disputes. This string is expected to contain specific parameters or data related to the dispute.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the payment reference.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the payment dispute.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListPaymentsPaymentsDisputesResponse_200.description: The response schema for the GET operation related to payment disputes.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the record was created by an automated process.

AuditDetails.description: Details about the audit trail for the payment dispute.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
